description: 127 steps with two players: the attributes on joining and when the other appears, each of the 39 effects at amplifiers 0 and 2 and cleared (instant health and damage, poison, wither, hunger, levitation and saturation at 0 for a second), health boost and absorption with the absorption, two modifiers on one attribute in either order, several attributes cleared at once, sprinting alone and with speed, a rejoin and a respawn with effects; attribute ids read raw and each packet's attributes sorted; Circuit and both official servers give the same, but for the ids, which differ between the versions
